//redirects: The five-page site became one page on 2026-09-23. These keep any link
already shared — a text message, the Facebook page, a business card —
landing on the right part of the new one instead of a 404.
Real 301s from the edge, not Astro's static redirects, which emit an
HTML page with a meta refresh: that is a crawlable document telling a
search engine a URL still exists, which is the opposite of what a
permanent redirect is for. The fragment survives the hop, so /services/
lands on the services block rather than the top of the page.
